thread:
darren: Thanks everyone for joining todays all-hands. Dropping the recording, slides, and a short owner list so nothing slips through the cracks.
darren: Recording: https://redwood.app/ah/248012  Slides: https://drive.google.com/redwood/ah-may-2026

darren: Quick note: I want single owners where possible so we can measure progress.

raj: Dedicated GA provisional window: week of June 2. Ill confirm final week after the release checklist passes.
raj: Canary approach: start 5% -> 25% -> 100%, with automatic fallback to the smaller model variant on error spike.
raj: Example rollout command for the release playbook:
```
rwctl rollout create --env dedicated --model rdw/dedicated-v1 --canary 5% --metric p95_latency
```

emily: Shipping plan for Redwood Optimize: GA will be as a paid add-on. Early-access customers get feature parity minus the managed suggestions UI.
emily: Im drafting a 1-pager billing explainer for the pilot customers. Expect to share Wed.

sophia: From leadership Q&A: two asks  keep rollback and safety gates non-negotiable; run a 10-day blackbox test against noisy traffic before GA sign-off.
sophia: Also requested a short FAQ for legal and procurement teams about data residency for Dedicated.

marta: DevEx will publish a Dedicated + Private quickstart template and sample configs by next Tue. Ill open a docs PR and ping reviewers.
marta: Reminder: examples should be copy-pasteable and focus on minimal infra required for a first request.

growth-lead: Growth will collect prompt sets for replay tests from two pilot teams and circulate by Fri. Owner: @growth-team.
growth-lead: Well also surface customer appetite for on-prem packaging to Sales to inform packaging decisions.

security-bot: New issue RDW-3458 created: KMS provider compatibility matrix. Security will maintain list and add integration notes for GA. https://issues.redwood/RDW-3458
security-bot: Please add any additional KMS vendors to the issue comments.

salesbot: Sales ask: add interested customers to RDW-PACKING sheet: https://sheets.redwood/packing
salesbot: I added three enterprise leads who asked about on-prem installers.

darren: Performance target recap from the all-hands: p95 < 350ms for standard chat loads on Dedicated with default batching. Owner: @eng-sre to validate across GPU profiles.
raj: Well add perf regression checks to CI and gate canary progress on no-regression over 24h.

emily: Prompt eval checklist (short): 1) baseline prompt set; 2) quality thresholds; 3) regression alert hooks + owner. Ill share a template Wed.

darren: Consolidated action items (Im adding these to the Notion follow-ups doc):
- Raj: Lock GA week and publish release checklist (due EOW)
- Emily: Billing explainer + Optimize access plan (Wed)
- Marta/DevEx: Quickstart template + docs PR (Tue)
- Security: KMS matrix RDW-3458 (ongoing)
- Growth/Sales: Collect prompt sets and on-prem interest (Fri)
- Eng-SRE: Validate p95 target across hardware (7 days)

sophia: Thanks for pulling the owners together  this is really helpful. :clap:
raj: Ill create a separate release-checklist thread tomorrow so checklist comments don't clog this stream.
marta: Will tag docs reviewers once PR is up and post the PR link here.
darren: Ill update the Notion doc after each owner closes an item: https://notion.redwood/ah-followups/248012

emily: One more note: we should include a short "what to tell customers" blurb in the billing explainer so pilots know when credits vs billed consumption apply.
growth-lead: Copy that, Ill coordinate with Emily to include customer-facing language.

darren: If anyone wants to take an owner off the list, please @me and propose an alternate owner so we can reassign cleanly.
security-bot: Reminder: add any compliance questions to RDW-3458 comments so we can triage during the GA compliance review.
salesbot: If you have customer names for the packing sheet, drop them in here or add directly to the sheet.

darren: Closing this thread and archiving owner list to the follow-ups doc. Ill post a weekly status update.
sophia: Thanks everyone!
